name: Full-Range Gap Continuation with a Gap-Fill Stop
note: Oxford Strategies 'Gap Pattern Type A'. Enter when a bar's ENTIRE range clears the prior bar's entire range (low[i] > high[i-1], not merely the prior close) AND the bar makes a new `chan`-bar extreme. The exit is the non-fill of the gap itself: a stop one tick inside high[i-1], so the trade is a bet that nobody transacts back at yesterday's extreme. Held long -- the source found longer holds preferred -- with a 6-ATR disaster stop and no profit target. The intraday no-retest variant of the idea is the same rule at a finer bar size, which is what a 5Min/1Min run of this file already is.
source: https://oxfordstrat.com/trading-strategies/gap-pattern/ - Gap Pattern Type A: long gap Low[i] > High[i-1], channel filter High[i] > UpperChannel[i-1] lookback 2-100, pattern exit 'one tick below the price gap', time exit 1-50 with longer holds preferred, ATR(20)x6 stop, rated B/C over 42 US futures markets. Type B (https://oxfordstrat.com/trading-strategies/gap-pattern-2/) uses the weaker Low[i] > Close[i-1] and rates C.

def family_init(ctx):
    """Full-range gaps plus a channel-breakout confirmation.

    A LONG bar is one whose ENTIRE range sits above the prior bar's entire
    range (low[i] > high[i-1]) and which also takes out the highest high of
    the previous `chan` bars. The level the gap cleared -- high[i-1] -- is
    remembered, because the exit is defined against it.
    """
    n = len(ctx.bars)
    hi = [b["h"] for b in ctx.bars]
    lo = [b["l"] for b in ctx.bars]
    L = max(2, int(ctx.p.chan))
    up = [None] * n
    dn = [None] * n
    for i in range(L, n):
        up[i] = max(hi[i - L:i])
        dn[i] = min(lo[i - L:i])
    ctx.up = ctx.series(up, "chan_up")
    ctx.dn = ctx.series(dn, "chan_dn")
    ctx.gap = None          # the level the gap cleared
    ctx.gdir = 0
    ctx.p.time_stop = int(ctx.p.hold)


def signal(ctx, i):
    if i < 1:
        return 0
    u, d = ctx.up[i], ctx.dn[i]
    if u is None or d is None:
        return 0
    ph, pl = ctx.h[i - 1], ctx.l[i - 1]
    if ph is None or pl is None:
        return 0
    # LONG: the whole bar trades above the whole prior bar, and it is also a
    # new `chan`-bar high.
    if ctx.l[i] > ph and ctx.h[i] > u:
        ctx.gap = ph
        ctx.gdir = 1
        return 1
    # SHORT: mirror.
    if ctx.h[i] < pl and ctx.l[i] < d:
        ctx.gap = pl
        ctx.gdir = -1
        return -1
    return 0


def exit_signal(ctx, i):
    """The pattern exit: the trade dies the moment the gap fills.

    One tick inside the level the gap cleared. This is the whole bet -- the
    gap was information only for as long as nobody traded back into it.
    """
    if ctx.gap is None or not ctx.positions:
        return False
    d = 1 if ctx.positions[0]["side"] == "long" else -1
    if d != ctx.gdir:
        return False
    if d > 0:
        return ctx.l[i] <= ctx.gap - ctx.p.tick
    return ctx.h[i] >= ctx.gap + ctx.p.tick
